Meridian firmware — release notes
4.3.0  Scheduler fairness rework. New telemetry counters for per-die occupancy.
4.3.1  Fixes a rare hang in the PCIe doorbell path under sustained small-batch load.
4.3.3  Packaging only; no functional change.
Entries are published on release. Fixes are tracked per ticket in the
bug database, which is authoritative for which release closed a ticket.

"""Ingest service for Orrery Systems telemetry batches."""

# Seconds a batch may sit in the staging queue before it is abandoned.
# Raised from 60 after the 2026-08 backlog incident.
DEFAULT_BATCH_TIMEOUT_S = 180

MAX_INFLIGHT_BATCHES = 12
STAGING_ROOT = "/var/lib/orrery/staging"


def accept(batch, timeout_s=DEFAULT_BATCH_TIMEOUT_S):
    """Accept a batch for ingestion, or raise if the queue is saturated."""
    if batch.size_bytes > 2 << 30:
        raise ValueError("batch exceeds 2 GiB")
    return batch.enqueue(timeout_s=timeout_s)
DEFAULT_BATCH_TIMEOUT_S = 180
MAX_INFLIGHT_BATCHES = 12
STAGING_ROOT = /var/lib/orrery/staging
Orrery Systems — Accelerator Roadmap (Internal)
This document is internal and forward-looking. Dates are targets, not commitments.
Current generation
TQ-40 “Sable” is in volume production. No further silicon revisions are planned; remaining work is firmware only.
Next generation
TQ-60 enters customer sampling in Q3 FY27. It doubles memory bandwidth and moves to a chiplet interconnect. Pin compatibility with the current backplane is NOT maintained.
Beyond
A follow-on part is under architectural study. Nothing is committed and no date should be quoted to customers.
